question: What attainment makes a practitioner dear to the yoginīs?
premises: Enjoyment and liberation can be attained together.
Great accomplishment arises from such attainment.
This accomplishment makes one dear to the yoginīs.
inference: One who attains great accomplishment in both enjoyment and liberation becomes dear to the yoginīs.
plain_english: He may become dear to the yoginīs through the great accomplishment of both enjoyment and liberation.
